reply: {"verses": [], "overall": "The translation follows the Latin closely in every verse: tenses (sperabam, finies, clamabo, meditabor, recogitabo, corripies, vivificabis), persons, the subjectless succidit and contrivit, the doubled vivens vivens, and Jerome's inferi/infernus/lacum are all kept without Hebrew smoothing. Supplied words (the copula 'está' in 38:20, the object 'o' in 38:18, 'nem' under the negation in 38:12, 'para longe de mim' for a me in 38:13) are within the working rule. Each verse carries a single mediant * in the same place as the Latin, with no flex or second mediant on either side."}
